translationRepairs: In summer of the first year of Changxing, Yan Prefecture reported that severe flooding entered the city and residents drowned.
In summer of the first year of Changxing, Fu Prefecture reported that severe flooding entered the city and residents drowned.
Chinese 鄜州 is Fu Prefecture; Yan would be 兗州 or 鄆州. The idiomatic line wrongly says Yan, and replacing it with Fu corrects the place-name without other changes.
In summer of the first year of Changxing, Yan Prefecture reported upward that great flooding entered the city and residents drowned.
In summer of the first year of Changxing, Fu Prefecture reported upward that great flooding entered the city and residents drowned.
The same misreading of 鄜州 as Yan appears in the literal field; Fu Prefecture matches 鄜, and the rest of the rendering already tracks the Chinese.

The border regions of Yan and Pu prefectures were inundated. Wei Bi, Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments; Guo Tingrang, Assistant Director of Imperial Construction; An Jun, General of the Right Golden Crow Guard; and Tian Jun, General of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guard, were dispatched to Hua, Pu, Cao, and Yan prefectures to inspect flood-damaged crops and to comfort the afflicted populace.

The border regions of Yan and Pu prefectures were inundated. Wei Bi, Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments; Guo Tingrang, Assistant Director of Imperial Construction; An Jun, General of the Right Golden Crow Guard; and Tian Jun, General of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guard, were dispatched to Hua, Pu, Chan, and Yun prefectures to inspect flood-damaged crops and to comfort the afflicted populace.

The inspection circuit is 滑、濮、澶、鄆—Hua, Pu, Chan, and Yun. Idiomatic Cao and Yan misread 澶 as 曹 and 鄆 as 兗; the proposed Chan and Yun restore the correct prefectures while leaving 兗州、濮州 in the opening clause as Yan and Pu.

The borders of Yan and Pu prefectures were all swept and drowned by water; Honglu Vice Minister Wei Bi, Assistant Director of Imperial Construction Guo Tingrang, General of the Right Golden Crow Guard An Jun, and General of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guard Tian Jun were ordered in the four prefectures of Hua, Pu, Cao, and Yan to inspect crops damaged by the river water and also to comfort and inquire after the common people who suffered flooding.

The borders of Yan and Pu prefectures were all swept and drowned by water; Honglu Vice Minister Wei Bi, Assistant Director of Imperial Construction Guo Tingrang, General of the Right Golden Crow Guard An Jun, and General of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guard Tian Jun were ordered in the four prefectures of Hua, Pu, Chan, and Yun to inspect crops damaged by the river water and also to comfort and inquire after the common people who suffered flooding.
Literal likewise has Cao and Yan for 澶、鄆; Chan and Yun are required. Opening 兗州、濮州 remains Yan and Pu, which the proposal correctly leaves unchanged.

The Liang Founder regarded it as strange and ordered it shown to the hundred officials, but none could explain its meaning. When the Later Jin High Ancestor took the throne, people reckoned that although the inscription bore the surname Tu, counting by the sexagenary cycle it had been twenty-nine years.

The Liang Founder regarded it as strange and ordered it shown to the hundred officials, but none could explain its meaning. When the Later Jin High Ancestor took the throne, people reckoned that although the diagram bore a surname, counting by the sexagenary cycle it had been twenty-nine years.
雖有圖姓 follows 乃圖其狀以進: 圖 is the diagram of the omen, not a surname Tu. Reading it as “the diagram bore a surname” matches the Chinese and removes the invented surname.

The Liang Founder regarded it as strange and ordered it shown to the hundred officials; none could explain its meaning. When the Jin High Ancestor took the throne, people thought that although there was the surname Tu, counting by the sexagenary cycle it was twenty-nine years.

The Liang Founder regarded it as strange and ordered it shown to the hundred officials; none could explain its meaning. When the Jin High Ancestor took the throne, people thought that although there was a surname in the diagram, counting by the sexagenary cycle it was twenty-nine years.
Literal “surname Tu” makes the same error; “a surname in the diagram” correctly takes 圖 with 姓 as the depicted surname, consistent with 圖其狀 in the preceding unit.
